texts.title: The Community Rule (1QS), columns I-XI
texts.source: Israel Museum photograph of scroll 1QS (Digital Dead Sea Scrolls) + ETCBC dss transcription (Abegg; CC BY-NC 4.0) + English of W. H. Brownlee, The Dead Sea Manual of Discipline (1951), public domain
texts.description: The Community Rule from Qumran Cave 1, complete in eleven columns: the covenant ceremony, the teaching on the two spirits, the rules and penal code of the Community and its closing hymn, each column shown on the Israel Museum's photograph of the scroll.

authors.name: Qumran community (Dead Sea Scrolls)
authors.bio: The Jewish community whose library of scrolls was found in the caves near Khirbet Qumran on the Dead Sea from 1947.
